newsitem.title: USA: Willingboro, N.J., sees property tax hike -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Willingboro, N.J., sees property tax hike -- paper.

text.p: The Willingboro, N.J., Board of Education on Tuesday approved a tentative $50.9 million budget for fiscal 1998, calling for teacher layoffs and higher property taxes, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Wednesday.
School officials said 39 employees's jobs would be eliminated next year, fewer than the 49.5 jobs targeted in an early draft of the budget.
Taxes would rise about 10.69 cents per $100 of assessed property value next year under the proposal.
The district lost $1.8 million in state aid because of a decline in enrollment, the paper reported.
Residents are set to vote on the budget on April 15.
